token.description: For TCP. The Unix socket needs none: its file permissions are the access control.

info.description: berth's API, served by `berth serve`. Each endpoint is one of berth's operations, with the rules the command line has: an operation that changes something needs a caller that may write; one that restarts a container needs a caller that may restart, and the org's name again as `confirm`. Secret values are never returned. Errors are berth.error/v1 documents.
